_doc: Ground-truth labels for the v2 screen classifier proving bench. Each clip lists per-frame expected states at 1 fps. Boundaries [t_start_sec, t_end_sec] are INCLUSIVE on both ends (1fps sampling means t=N corresponds to source video second N). See README.md for the operator labeling workflow.

clips.name: match-968-menu-sequence
clips.description: Match 968 first 60s: the original failure case. The session navigates CLUB management → PLAYER LOADOUTS hub → loadout detail → back to lobby → WORLD OF CHEL splash → SEASON 4 leaderboard recap → OPENING CLASH cutscene. v1 mis-classified the CLUB/loadout/WoC spans as pre_game_lobby_state_2, contaminating the typed lobby extractor. v2 must classify these correctly OR fall back to unknown_or_transition for the two deferred classes (menu_club_management, player_loadout_landing).

Back in the lobby after exiting loadouts; both teams visible with all-READY status.
WORLD OF CHEL splash transition. Stylized title at mid-frame; OCR typically can't read it.
Season 4 ELITE CUP CHAMPIONS leaderboard recap — same OOD screen as match-250's t=52-59. Tightened by the leaderboard_cup reject prior in S5.5.
'OPENING CLASH' pre-game cutscene (team banners, BM vs mtl) — closest legitimate state for a loading-style intro.
